strategy.manuscriptMarkdown:
# Iridium Certus 9604 Hybrid IoT module: cellular where you can, satellite where you must.

## The argument

One module. Both layers. Your logic.

## Phases

### Recognise (Weeks 1-3)

Make Devices go dark outside cellular coverage and the missed transmission costs more than the module. Iridium's hybrid module became commercially available in June 2026. visible to Product managers and embedded engineers who spec the device; operations leaders who own the cost of a dark asset; system integrators building connected products..

### Prove (Weeks 4-8)

Show the mechanism behind Iridium Certus 9604 Hybrid IoT module: cellular where you can, satellite where you must. in real contexts.

### Convert (Weeks 9-12)

Give engaged readers a practical tool and a clear next step.

## Measurement

Primary KPI tracked weekly; diagnostic measures per channel.

research.summary: M2M Group (M2M One Pty Ltd, M2M Connectivity Pty Ltd, M2M One NZ Ltd) can win by attaching Iridium Certus 9604 Hybrid IoT module: cellular where you can, satellite where you must. to the moment "Devices go dark outside cellular coverage and the missed transmission costs more than the module. Iridium's hybrid module became commercially available in June 2026." becomes visible to Product managers and embedded engineers who spec the device; operations leaders who own the cost of a dark asset; system integrators building connected products.. Documented facts are usable; customer proof is not yet approved. Alternatives compete on price and reach rather than the specific problem. The campaign should name the problem first and prove the mechanism second.

insights.statement: the offer has documented capabilities that can be cited by name.
insights.implication: Lead with documented facts; keep undocumented claims out of copy.

insights.statement: Routing between layers is designed by the developer, never automatic.
insights.implication: Never promise automatic failover or universal coverage.

insights.statement: "a change that makes the current approach less reliable" is becoming more visible to the people who decide in Australia and New Zealand.
insights.implication: Attach the campaign to this trigger; timing beats reach.

insights.statement: the people who decide are the people who feel the problem first and shape the decision.
insights.implication: Address them first; give them a way to make the case internally.

insights.statement: Alternatives in the buyer's consideration set compete on price and reach, not on the specific problem.
insights.implication: Own the problem statement; avoid a feature-versus-feature message.

insights.statement: The campaign can win by naming the moment the problem becomes visible, not by listing features.
insights.implication: Core message = the boundary or trigger; proof follows.
